reviews.text: Great local store to get pet foods from. Shop there all the time. The staff are warm and friendly
super frendly high noleg in food highly recemend to all
Excellent service! Employees are always polite and patient.
They partner with a local cat rescue to help adopt out cats. A very cat friendly store. Good selection of products and food.
Been going here for 10 years.

I had an abhorrent experience here today. I was racially profiled and followed by 2 staff members who even went as far as to get two of their customers or friends who happened to be in the store.

At first they offered to help me find something. I declined the offer as I was simply here to browse and reminisce - I adopted my cat from this store years ago when I used to live in the area.

After a few minutes i could tell i was being followed and watched. The tall older Caucasian lady with darker hair made it very clear that they were really keen to keep their eyes on me. Continuing to ask “Is there something we can help you find”. After repeatedly declining the offer i began to feel very uncomfortable and unwelcome.

As I began to move to exit the store I noticed another team member (younger asian girl) concealing herself behind a shelf - as we locked eyes she immediately asked if there was something she could help me find- at this point after having rejected their offer to “help me find something” multiple times, and being clearly followed, i had to leave.
The entire experience was so off putting and vile.

Preciously I have had nothing but wonderful experiences here. This current team is poorly trained on mitigating what they ignorantly perceive as a potential shoplifter - or what ever they thought I was in there for.

I hope they learn to do better in the future, and service their clients with care rather than assumptions.

I really can't say enough about Tamara, I think she may manage the store. She is the most helpful person I have ever found in a per store. Everyone is important to her, she knows everything to with your pet. Thankyou Tamara...
ALL of the staff here are positive, knowledgeable, and friendly! They treat their customers with respect, and they have exceptionally great service and prices! 5 star, Community driven business!
Everyone is very friendly and knowledgeable. Great store and highly recommended it.
Great selection of food, toys and accessories and even better staff!

I'm writing this review months after the fact.
Helpful staff, I came in with my cat to buy a harness and leash. Staff was super helpful in advising on sizing. I was able to try it on my cat in store before purchasing. I use this harness with her every single day for walks and put it through the washing machine to clean and no issues. A quality product.

I've been bringing my cats to Ronnie the grooming for two years now, today was the same as any other visit there. Amazing. Friendly. Always clean environment. Communication is amazing. Ronnie takes care of my cats and they allow him to groom him with no problems. I can't even get my cat to let me touch his tummy. But he lets Ronnie. Ronnie is a miracle worker! I will only bring my cats here for grooming and advice others to do so. The care he takes with animals is amazing. 5 stars

Vancouver Pet Food and Supply has a great selection of products, and the staff are incredibly friendly — they greet you warmly as soon as you walk in. There’s also convenient parking right behind the building, making it easy to load heavy bags of pet food into your car. Overall, a super convenient and welcoming place. Highly recommend!

Updated edit: they've been under new ownership in the past few years and I have no complaints. Lovely store, lovely staff, great stock of everything you need. They regularly go above and beyond for us. Highly recommend!!

Old review (4 stars): this is a great local pet store, they're super helpful, stock most things you need, and are really nice. I took a star off though, because they don't seem to stick to their hours. My family and I have shown up multiple (probably 4 or 5) times within 10-15 minutes before their closing time to find them already completely closed (gates across, sign in, locked and no one in sight). Just be aware before you drive across town to get to them, that it's best to show up well before closing!

I went to get my cat groomed, a lion cut, nothing to say about the cut, the staff is nice, the only one who chose it was that when I came home and examined my cat there was a little black thing, I who only thought it was dust when I got closer to remove it I saw the dust in question moving in his hair so I took a pair of tweezers and I was able to remove it from between his hair when I looked what it was it was a dog flea! My cat is an indoor cat, he never goes out and he has never had fleas in his entire life!! I am really disgusted to bring home fleas on my cat I will not come back for sure!!!! Be careful

We been taking our dog to this place for haircut the last 3-4 years maybe more since we started they are charging more every single time it’s never been consistent.
Every haircut different price⬆️
Even our dog is same weight for the last 8 years.
Last time it was $110 now today 4-5 months later is $126 when we started it was $75.
We do understand inflation but this is becoming ridiculous.
I found a new place that charges $80 with tax for the same haircut.
That’s a $46 difference.
I tried to support our local business by I feel like we been ripped off.
Is it legal for them to charge me taxes before discount? I've never experienced this at other stores. All I got from the cashier was, "yeah, taxes are crazy". I will never come back.
Knowledgeable and friendly staff
Always kind and helpful.  Been going here for years.

I was in a few weeks ago to have my longhair cat Missy groomed. She was so badly matted, so Ronnie suggested a lion cut. I was pretty apprehensive as I have had zero experience with cat grooming. I was beyond impressed! Ronnie put myself and Missy immediately at ease. We were in and out in less than a half an hour and he did an amazing job at a very reasonable price. She looks adorable and our house is so much cleaner! I plan to keep up the grooming with Ronnie every couple of months and I highly recommend this to anyone with a longhair. You’re the best Ronnie! See you soon!
A good local independent pet store.  Large selection of frozen raw food for dogs and cats.
My partner and I love them. They are really sweet. ❤️❤️❤️ And genuine.
You won’t find better customer service around. They always help me carry my items to the car. I really appreciate this business.
My dog loves this store.  Staff is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable.
Booked my cat to see the groomer...they canceled the appointment
